ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Advanced Port Scanner Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of Advanced Port Scanner.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\advanced\\_port\\_scanner.*") OR process_original_file_name = RGX(".*advanced\\_port\\_scanner.*") OR process_description = RGX(".*Advanced\\ Port\\ Scanner.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/portable.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/lng.*")))
